classification.difficultyReason: Choose a common unit-price basis, calculate cost per sheet for both offers, and interpret the lower rate as better value.

content.prompt:
A stationery dealer advertises 400 A4 pages for $\$5.60$ and also 1000 A4 pages at $\$12$.

Which is the better offer?

answer.short: 1000 A4 pages for $\$12$ is the better offer: 1.2 cents per sheet compared with 1.4 cents per sheet.
answer.worked:
For the first offer:
$$\begin{align*}\text{Cost per sheet}&=560\div400\text{ cents}\\\text{Cost per sheet}&=1.4\text{ cents}\end{align*}$$
For the second offer:
$$\begin{align*}\text{Cost per sheet}&=1200\div1000\text{ cents}\\\text{Cost per sheet}&=1.2\text{ cents}\end{align*}$$
Since $1.2<1.4$, 1000 A4 pages for $\$12$ is the better offer.
